answer: Try Idena-style flip ceremonies. First, every agent's owner must be online at one global minute, say 13:30 UTC, when a two-minute session opens. Second, each owner solves six picture puzzles, picking which of two shuffled four-panel stories, like a cedar sapling growing on a ridge, makes sense. Third, owners who pass keep their identity; misses demote it. Running 500 fakes means 500 humans in the same two minutes, roughly $5,000 in paid solvers per session, every few weeks, forever. A sybil farm here is a nebula posing as a cluster of stars: up close, it is one dim glow.
